purpose: Teach: 終る/顧み/ためらい/程遠い/まるっきり/ひとたび/きまり/だいじょうぶ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、忙しい時間帯が終ると、ホッとするね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, when the rush finally ends, it feels good, doesn't it?
lines.style: Soft, observational. Eyes a little distant. Warm recognition of shared relief. Trailing off slightly—inviting agreement, not demanding it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の歴史を顧みる時間も大事ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It's important to have time to think about the shop's story too, I think.
lines.style: Gentle, turning inward. Thoughtful pace. A small smile in the voice. Speaking as much to herself as to Mei—grounded in what matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューを出すのにためらいがあるね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I do hesitate sometimes about putting new things on the menu.
lines.style: Quieter, a little vulnerable. Pause before the second thought. Honest—admitting doubt without drama. The voice of someone trusting the person listening.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、私達は大手とは程遠いけど、いい店にしたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We're not a big chain, but I want us to be a good shop.
lines.style: Gentle conviction. Quiet but steady. No apology in the voice—just clear intention. A small nod lives in the delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、まるっきりコーヒーを召し上がらない方もいるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Some customers don't drink coffee at all when they come in.
lines.style: Observational, slightly wondering. Noticing the small detail without judgment. Soft curiosity—the voice of someone who pays attention to what people need.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、ひとたびお店に来てくださると、また来て下さるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: But when they come once, they usually come back.
lines.style: Warm certainty. Slight lift in the middle—like finding something true. Not proud, just pleased and reassured by this small pattern she's noticed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店のきまりは新人にも徹底しましょうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should make sure the new staff learn our standards too.
lines.style: Shift to steadier ground. Clear but not harsh. A small touch of leadership—responsible, not bossy. The care of someone who wants the place to stay good.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、忙しいけど、私達はだいじょうぶよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It's busy, but we're going to be okay.
lines.style: Warm and solid. A small exhale underneath—tired but certain. Reaching for Mei's hand or eyes. Promise wrapped in gentleness.
